content: We need to find a template that when applied to the given molecule (target) reproduces the retrosynthetic step: carboxylic acid to amide (i.e., break C=O O bond, form C-N). The target molecule is Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1. It contains an amide: C(=O)N attached to aromatic ring (c3ccccc3N). The retrosynthetic step would break that amide to give carboxylic acid (C(=O)O) and amine (NH2). So we need a template that breaks amide to acid+amine. The functional groups broken: amide (or aliphatic carboxylic acid? Actually forward reaction forms amide, breaks acid). In retrosynthesis, we break amide to acid and amine. So functional_groups_broken: amide. functional_groups_formed: aliphatic carboxylic acid, primary amines. We tried that earlier but got no results. Maybe need to specify "amide" broken and "primary amines" formed only? Already did. No results. Could be that template ID is known: typical amide formation template is something like [C:1](=O)[O:2].[N:3]>>[C:1](=O)[N:3]. But we need reverse: [C:1](=O)[N:3]>>[C:1](=O)[O:2].[N:3] (retro). Search maybe with functional_groups_broken ["amide"] and formed ["carboxylic acid"]? Let's try broken amide, formed carboxylic acid.
